# Contributing to `pipx`

Thank you for your interest in contributing to pipx! We expect all contributors to follow the
[PSF Code of Conduct][coc].

## Development Documentation

Our [development documentation](https://pipx.pypa.io/latest/contributing.html) explains how to start contributing to
`pipx` and how we develop it.

[coc]: https://github.com/pypa/.github/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md
